findings.note: Code-only. The rider is printed on the CONSCIOUS MIND (conscious-mind-7), not on the spell, so it may not be written onto the spells/telekinetic-projectile record: 30 feet is the correct range for every caster who is not a Distant Grasp psychic. Ruling G's per-character lane is SPELL_MARKERS in src/rules/situationalBonuses.ts, keyed by spell id and gated on owning the source record; it renders through explain.ts spellSituationalFor into SpellsTab.tsx. No backfill row can express a gated per-character modification.

Code-only, same lane and same reason as the projectile rung. The 1/2/3-Bulk ladder is a carrying limit the sheet stores in no field (no reader exists for a spell Bulk cap anywhere in build.ts or derive.ts), so the printed ladder rides the SPELL_MARKERS bonus text rather than a number.

Code-only. The clause moves the TARGET's circumstance bonus to AC (ruling F, someone else's roll), so no stat row of this character's sheet can hold it and no record field on spells/phase-bolt would be true for other casters. SPELL_MARKERS keyed 'phase-bolt', source 'the-unbound-step'.

Code-only. Both halves are FEAT_SITUATIONAL stars in src/rules/situationalBonuses.ts: the existing save line's `when` was truncated at an ellipsis (poison, fatigued and sickened were never displayed) and the DC 10 persistent-bleed flat check had no line at all.
